capcut.template_note: The empty template every project is cloned from (the CapCut MCP's CAPCUT_TEMPLATE_DRAFT). Never delete or edit it.
capcut.pro_note: This PC has no CapCut Pro: a project that holds a Pro option will not export. false = capcut-transitions and capcut-text-anim use only what data/capcut-catalogue.md marks as drawn by this PC's CapCut and not Pro.
capcut.store_lock_note: One lock file for every toolkit on this PC that writes CapCut's shared project index (root_meta_info.json): capcut-repair takes it, and capcut-build holds it while it writes a project. Do not point it anywhere else.
capcut.mcp_core_note: The CapCut MCP's own library: the code the configured capcut MCP server (server.js beside it) runs for every capcut_* tool. capcut-build loads it in one Node process (scripts/capcut_build.mjs) to write a whole project; nothing here edits it.
